summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K to report amendments to a master repurchase agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA. The amendments increase available financing for loan acquisition/origination to up to $1.3 billion during a temporary 180-day period, and adjust financial covenants including a liquidity requirement of at least $10 million or 10% of purchase price (capped at $50 million). The filing is a routine update to a credit facility, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms were announced.
